description: Agent Bank private proofs cross-language vectors (schema agentbank.claims.v1). Secrets and keys here are public test values; never use them for anything real.

proof.description: A gate-issued request (createProofGate with gate.key_utf8 at gate.now) and the agent's presentation from its reservation leaf. A ProofGate configured like `gate` must accept AGENT-PROOF = base64(json({ request, presentation })) at gate.now when the root resolves to root_info, then refuse the same header as nonce_reused.
